# `/authorization` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels

`createCustomUserLevelV1` — Create a custom user level — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Creates a new custom user level for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): userlevelrequest
- Returns 200: userlevelsummarydto

### GET /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels

`listUserLevelsV1` — List user levels — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Retrieves a list of user levels for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `detailLevel` (query) — default basic — one of FULL, SLIM — Specifies the level of detail for the user levels.
  - `filters` (query) — fields: name: co; owner: co; status: eq; description: co — e.g. `name co "identity", owner co "john", status eq "active", description co "some description"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, description, status, owner — e.g. `name, -created, description, status, owner`
  - `limit` (query) — max 50 — default 50 — Note that for this API the maximum value for limit is 50. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of userlevelsummarydto

### POST /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels/{id}/publish

`publishCustomUserLevelV1` — Publish a custom user level — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Publishes a custom user level for the tenant, making it active and available.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the user level to publish.
- Returns 200: userlevelpublishsummary

### GET /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels/{id}

`getUserLevelV1` — Retrieve a user level — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Fetches the details of a specific user level by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the user level.
- Returns 200: userlevelsummarydto

### DELETE /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels/{id}

`deleteUserLevelV1` — Delete a user level — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Deletes a specific user level by its ID.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the user level.
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /authorization/v1/custom-user-levels/{id}

`updateUserLevelV1` — Update a user level — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Updates the details of a specific user level using JSON Patch.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the user level.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): jsonpatch
- Returns 200: userlevelsummarydto

### GET /authorization/v1/authorization-assignable-right-sets

`listAllAuthorizationRightSetsV1` — List all uiAssignable right sets — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Retrieves a list of authorization assignable right sets for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: category: eq — e.g. `category eq "identity"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, category — e.g. `name, -id, -category`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of hierarchicalrightset

### GET /authorization/v1/user-levels/{id}/identities

`listUserLevelIdentitiesV1` — List user level identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

List of identities associated with a user level.

- Scopes: idn:user-level:manage, idn:user-level:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the user level.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If true, X-Total-Count header with the the total number of identities for this user level will be included in the response.
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: displayName — e.g. `displayName`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of authuserslimresponse

### POST /authorization/v1/user-levels/get-identity-count

`showUserLevelCountsV1` — Count user levels identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

- Returns 200: array of authuserlevelsidentitycount
